title: The work order note and Audit Log match, including the line count
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in with 'Work order lines - Create & Edit' and 'Work orders - Create & Edit', on the build under test; ShopCoach is enabled and the shop has at least one labor type.
  2. A completed inspection with at least one Monitor or Not OK finding, run on a work order. Seed it: open a work order (Work Orders > New, pick a customer and unit), start an inspection from a template with a checkbox field, mark one field Not OK and one Monitor, then complete and sign it.
  3. Complete a build that created a known number of lines (e.g. 3 lines). Open both the work order Notes tab and the Audit Log.
custom_steps:
1. Open the note and the Audit Log entry and compare their facts.
2. Confirm both carry the same three facts: that the work order was built from an inspection, which inspection, and which work order the inspection was run on — neither missing a fact the other has.
3. Confirm both state how many lines were created, and the asset row reads e.g. '3 lines added' rather than 'Lines added'.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • The Audit Log entry and the note carry the same three facts — that it was built from an inspection, which inspection, and which run-on work order — with neither missing a fact the other has.
  • Both records state how many lines were created, and the asset row reads for example "3 lines added" rather than "Lines added".

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-8181, story SV-9105 (S7 — Record where the lines came from); Digital Inspections V2 specification, Confluence page 768507905, section S7; read on 22 September 2026.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S7-R7: “The Audit Log entry and the note will carry the same three facts: that the work order was built from an inspection, which inspection, and which work order the inspection was run on. Whichever a user opens, they get the same account. Neither may carry a fact the other lacks”
  • S7-R8: “Both records will state how many lines were created, and the asset row will read "3 lines added" rather than "Lines added". The count is known when the record is written, and the scale of what was added is the first thing an advisor wants from it”

Last checked against build v26.36.8-2a64085 on 10/1/2026.
